summary: Orchid Island Capital, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders and a dividend declaration. Stockholders voted on director elections, ratification of BDO USA as auditor, and advisory compensation proposals. All director nominees were elected, and all proposals were approved. Additionally, the Board declared a monthly dividend of $0.10 per common share for June 2026. This filing is a routine current report covering standard shareholder meeting outcomes and a regular dividend declaration with no terms or events that constitute a special situation such as an acquisition, activist campaign, or restructuring.
